Title: Q- LSJ. Vessel vs Secure Haven

Messages.Author: SteveHarris
Messages.Body:
If Meth A plays a Vessel and decides to burn a blood doll on Vampire 1
controlled by Meth B, and Vampire 1 has a Secure Haven, does Meth A
pay 1 more pool for Vessel?

Name: Vessel
Cardtype: Master
Cost: 1 pool
Master: trifle.
Put this card on a vampire, and you may burn a Blood Doll in play (if
any). During this vampire's controller's untap phase, he or she may
move 1 blood from this vampire to his or her pool or from his or her
pool to this vampire.

Name: Secure Haven
Cardtype: Master
Cost: 1 pool
Master: unique location. Haven.
Put this card on a minion you control. This minion cannot be -{the
target of other Methuselahs' actions}-. Any Methuselah burns an
additional pool when playing master cards on (or that target) this
minion. Burn this card if this minion enters torpor. A minion may have
only one haven.

Messages.Author: Dasein
Messages.Body:


No I don't think so. Vessel targets the Blood Doll card, not the
minion.
Same with say Tier of Souls. If I have a Tier of Souls on my guy, and
you try to burn it, I can't play Detect Authority at ani, nor would I
be able to get +1 intercept from Communal Haven: Temple. Targeting
cards placed on a minion != targeting the minion itself.
At least I'm pretty sure.
